items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I love, as I told you Art Tatum was one of the original geniuses of jazz, like Louis Armstrong, like Bix Beiderbecke.

ctx.x: Interesting statement. How to play for the clarinet.

There’s a certain way, certain registers of the instrument, the piano, that you can utilize behind a clarinet that makes it sing or brings it out, and Oscar is number one in that area, as opposed to say, I love, as I told you Art Tatum was one of the original geniuses of jazz, like Louis Armstrong, like Bix Beiderbecke. But very difficult to play with. And he did not enhance the clarinet, Art Tatum. He was really on his own and you played your clarinet to suit him. It was his ball game, as opposed to Oscar, who…
That’s very interesting. What is in the future for you?
